title: Great trip. Excellent driver. Educational and fun.
text: José was a fantastic guide and driver. The trip to Gaudix and the Geopark was great. It was nice to be out in nature and see the vistas on the fringes of the dessert as well as other views of the distant mountains.  Jose was very flexible, allowing me ample time, more than what I expected. He was quick to discuss everything typical of Andalusia, from food to topography, to the climate, and culture. I highly recommend the trip if you want a break away from the city. The walking was minimal.
author: michaelb664

title: Fantastic Tour of the High Desert
text: We had a great tour with Carlos.  It was scheduled as a small group tour but turned into a private tour when no one else signed up.  Lucky us!  It's hard to describe all the areas we visited as they were unique and something we have never seen before.  Anyhow, everything far exceeded our expectations and it was one of the highlights of our 3 week trip to southern Spain.  Good weather was a bonus.
author: Pigeon_Point_Pops

title: The emotion of freedom and joy will not be erased from my heart after this wonderful Journey with Good Vibes.
text: Travel with Buena Vibra. He arranged for us to meet the extraordinary in nature. A very complete experience, I had not imagined such a trip in my life. We're coordinating with them next trip. The emotion of freedom and joy will not be erased from my heart after this wonderful Journey with Good Vibes.
author: viajaconbuenavibra

title: Great day out at Geopark
text: Had a great day out at the Geopark with our lovely guide Carlos. There were only 5 of us on the trip 2 Welsh and 3 Spanish and Carlos patiently translated everything for us. We were able to visit sites that would be missed had we not been with a guide and learned at lot on the day. We had spectacular views over the valleys and enjoyed Guadix with its quirky houses in the caves. Great day out
author: Dianna M

title: Great tour of Geopark and surrounding area
text: A fabulous day out, just 5 of us and our lovely guide/driver Carlos. He made the day with his knowledge and care for us, making sure the multi national group understood everything.
author: Sally G
